title: Blink vs v0: Complete App Builder vs UI Component Generator
summary: Blink vs v0 by Vercel compared: database, auth, hosting, component generation, pricing. Which AI builder belongs in your 2026 stack?
body_markdown: v0 generates UI components and frontend apps optimized for the Vercel/Next.js ecosystem. Blink generates complete full-stack applications with database, auth, and hosting included automatically. v0 is best for component generation and extending existing Next.js projects; Blink is best for building new full-stack apps from scratch.
